prompts.concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reference concept for a Spine 2D skeletal animation exercise. Create one charming small delivery robot, full body centered, front view with a very slight three-quarter turn, in a neutral relaxed A pose. Cream rounded torso, orange accent panels, dark charcoal mechanical joints, separate clearly readable head, upper arms, forearms, mitten hands, thighs, shins and broad feet. Simple polished 2D game illustration with clean dark outlines, flat restrained shading and consistent soft light. Short limbs but enough length to rig elbows and knees. Face a dark screen with two friendly cyan eyes. No package or accessories obscuring limbs. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Entire robot visible with generous margins. This is the assembled design reference, not an exploded parts sheet.
prompts.parts: Use case: identity-preserve. Use the previous robot concept as the design reference. Produce ONE clean 2D game animation cutout parts sheet for this exact cream orange cyan robot, on a plain pure white background WITHOUT any glow, gradient, shadows, checkerboard, text or labels. Four columns and four rows of isolated separate pieces, with wide white gaps. 16 cells: row 1 head including antenna / torso including neck / pelvis / empty; row 2 viewer-left upper arm with round shoulder joint / viewer-left forearm with round elbow joint / viewer-left mitten hand / empty; row 3 viewer-right upper arm with round shoulder joint / viewer-right forearm with round elbow joint / viewer-right mitten hand / empty; row 4 viewer-left thigh / viewer-left shin / viewer-left foot / empty. This sheet is for evaluating consistent separated parts, not a finished rig. Keep same clean dark outlines, cream and orange panels and cyan lights. Each limb straight in neutral downward orientation; every part fully drawn including hidden overlap around joints, no parts touching, no assembled robot, no duplicate full characters. Maintain consistent relative scale of robot parts. Use pure white rather than painted transparency.
prompts.partsFix: Edit the supplied robot parts sheet. Preserve the robot identity, head, torso, pelvis, forearms, hands and leg pieces. Fix ONLY the first column in the second and third rows: each currently incorrectly shows an entire arm including forearm. Replace each with ONLY its short upper arm: orange rounded shoulder cap, dark circular shoulder pivot, short cream bicep segment, and dark rounded elbow connector. Remove the long forearm segment from these two upper-arm cells. Keep all pieces separated in the same layout. Additionally replace the white backdrop with genuine fully transparent alpha, with no glow, no white fringe and no cast shadows. No text. All pieces must retain clean opaque interior colors.
prompts.alphaAttempt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the robot parts sheet from the previous image. Remove ALL of the checkerboard background completely to actual alpha transparency. The checkerboard must NOT be painted into the image. Deliver a PNG with genuine transparent pixels around every isolated part, exactly like a clean sticker cutout file. Keep the 12 robot parts unchanged in appearance and placement, including their dark outlines and opaque cream interiors. No glow, no cast shadow, no background of any kind, no added pixels outside the parts. This request is specifically a real transparent background removal edit, not a visual representation of transparency.
